intro: This edition of The Builder's Brief highlights the latest advancements in AI models, agents, and research, with a focus on practical applications and real-world implications. From multimodal models to AI safety and alignment, we've curated the top 12 articles that matter most to builders.

curated_items.title: The Parts Are Greater Than the Sum: Automated Task Sequencing for Efficient Training of Multi-Policy LLMs
curated_items.summary: This paper proposes a method for automated task sequencing to improve the efficiency of training multi-policy LLMs. The approach reduces interference and catastrophic forgetting, leading to better transfer and adaptation. The authors demonstrate the effectiveness of their method through experiments.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use this approach to improve the efficiency of their LLM training pipelines and adapt to new tasks and domains.

curated_items.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
curated_items.summary: This article discusses the recent price drop of GPT-5.6 and its implications for the AI industry. The author highlights the improved price-performance ratio and the potential for increased adoption.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can take advantage of the improved price-performance ratio to deploy more efficient and cost-effective AI models.

curated_items.title: AgentHPOBench: A Benchmark For Evaluating LLM Agents as Sequential Hyperparameter Optimizers
curated_items.summary: This paper introduces AgentHPOBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents as sequential hyperparameter optimizers. The benchmark assesses the ability of LLM agents to conduct experiments and optimize hyperparameters.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use AgentHPOBench to evaluate and improve the performance of their LLM agents in hyperparameter optimization tasks.

curated_items.title: Investing in multi-agent AI safety research
curated_items.summary: This article announces a $10M funding call for multi-agent AI safety research. The goal is to advance the development of safe and reliable multi-agent AI systems.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can apply for funding to support their research in multi-agent AI safety and contribute to the development of more reliable AI systems.

curated_items.title: CodeShrink: Adaptive Visual Compression for Efficient Multimodal Code Understanding
curated_items.summary: This paper proposes CodeShrink, a method for adaptive visual compression of source code. The approach reduces the input costs of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and improves code understanding.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use CodeShrink to improve the efficiency of their MLLM-based code analysis and understanding tools.

curated_items.title: lamhotsiagian/llm-system-design
curated_items.summary: This repository provides a production-grade LLM system design platform and interactive lab. It features a pure-Python LLM serving, RAG, routing, safety, and agent control plane.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use this platform to design and deploy their own LLM-based systems and agents.

curated_items.title: How avatarin built a 24/7 retail agent with GPT-Realtime
curated_items.summary: This article discusses how avatarin built a 24/7 retail agent using GPT-Realtime. The agent provides multilingual support and has received positive feedback from users.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use GPT-Realtime to build their own conversational agents and provide 24/7 support to their users.

curated_items.title: FibVLA: An Efficient Temporal Vision-Language-Action Model with Fibonacci Sampling
curated_items.summary: This paper proposes FibVLA, a temporal vision-language-action model that uses Fibonacci sampling to improve efficiency. The model is designed for embodied AI applications.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use FibVLA to develop more efficient and effective embodied AI systems that can perceive and interact with their environment.

curated_items.title: AirLLM 70B inference with single 4GB GPU
curated_items.summary: This repository provides a implementation of AirLLM, a 70B parameter LLM that can run on a single 4GB GPU. The model is designed for efficient inference and can be used for a variety of NLP tasks.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use AirLLM to deploy efficient and cost-effective LLMs for their NLP applications.

curated_items.title: RayViT: Ray-Conditioned Visual Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Imitation Learning
curated_items.summary: This paper proposes RayViT, a ray-conditioned vision transformer encoder for viewpoint-robust imitation learning. The approach improves the robustness of learned policies to camera perturbations.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use RayViT to develop more robust and reliable imitation learning systems that can adapt to changing environments and viewpoints.

curated_items.title: vedaant00/opendot
curated_items.summary: This repository provides a terminal AI agent that can be fully undone, with every file and shell action snapshotted and reversible. The agent is model-agnostic and connects to 1000+ app tools and MCP servers.
curated_items.why_builders_care: Builders can use this agent to develop more transparent and accountable AI systems that can be easily audited and debugged.
